description: Update an add-on installed on an NKS cluster — change its version and/or configurationValues. At least one of version/configurationValues/resolveConflicts must be provided.

addonRef.description: Installed add-on reference: the add-on name OR the installed add-on's UUID

configurationValues.description: Helm values override as a JSON-object STRING. An empty string resets to {}

version.description: Target version. Omit to keep the current version

name: ncloud_nks_update_addon
